item.title: Portion of MLK Parkway closed due to icy roads
item.description: Wilmington Police Department is warning drivers about icy road conditions and says Martin Luther King Jr. Parkway is now closed.

item.title: National Guard mobilizes in Cape Fear to help with winter storm
item.description: North Carolina National Guard mobilizes in Cape Fear to help with emergencies.

item.title: Novant Health names neuroscience institute for Deloris Jordan, mother of Michael Jordan
item.description: The mother of Michael Jordan was honored Saturday during a special ceremony as Novant Health officially named its neuroscience institute after her.

item.title: Winter conditions throughout the Cape Fear region
item.description: WWAY travels from Columbus County to Brunswick County to share how things were looking like during the day under the winter conditions.

item.title: Snow on Wilmington beaches as winter weather moves through
item.description: WWAY was at the Oceanic Pier during high tide as waves were crashing ashore and snow flurries fell across the Wilmington area.

item.title: Highway Patrol reports 750 crashes statewide by 6pm during winter storm
item.description: The North Carolina State Highway Patrol reported 750 collisions statewide during a winter storm period spanning from 12 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Saturday.

item.title: I-85 NB reopens in NC after leaving more than 100 vehicles stranded
item.description: Interstate 85 is closed in both directions in Kannapolis due to hazardous weather conditions.

item.title: Sunset Beach Bridge may close as conditions worsen
item.description: The Sunset Beach Police Department is warning drivers that the Sunset Beach Bridge may close as road conditions continue to worsen.

item.title: Odell Williamson Bridge in Ocean Isle Beach closed as of 10pm
item.description: The Town of Ocean Isle Beach has announced that the Odell Williamson Bridge is closed as of 10pm due to deteriorating road conditions.

item.title: A look at the impact the winter storm had on the Cape Fear region as it hit
item.description: Highway 17 is usually one of the busiest roads in Leland, but as snow began to fall, it was virtually empty during near whiteout conditions.
